'''''Food & Wine''''' is an American monthly [[magazine]] published by [[People Inc.]]. It was founded in 1978<ref>{{cite web|title=Top 100 U.S. Magazines by Circulation|url=http://www.psaresearch.com/images/TOPMAGAZINES.pdf|work=PSA Research Center|access-date=June 4, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161115225953/http://www.psaresearch.com/images/TOPMAGAZINES.pdf|archive-date=November 15, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author-first1=Terrie L. |author-last1=Wilson |title=Tasty Selections: An Evaluation of Gourmet Food Magazines|journal=Journal of Agricultural & Food Information|date=2003|volume=5|issue=2|pages=49–66 |doi=10.1300/J108v05n02_06|s2cid=144410329}}</ref> by Ariane and [[Michael Batterberry]].  It features [[recipes]], [[Cookbook|cooking tips]], [[Travel literature|travel information]], [[Restaurant rating|restaurant reviews]], [[chef]]s, [[Wine and food pairing|wine pairings]] and seasonal/holiday content and has been credited by ''[[The New York Times]]'' with introducing the dining public to "[[Perrier]], the [[blue potato|purple Peruvian potato]] and [[Patagonian toothfish]]".

The premier event for the magazine is the Food & Wine Classic in [[Aspen, Colorado]]. The Classic features [[wine tasting]], [[Culinary arts|cooking demonstrations]], and [[Keynote|featured speakers]] as well as a [[Cook-off|cooking competition]]. Held annually in June, the event is considered the kickoff to the [[Aspen#Habitat and longevity|Aspen summer season]] and celebrated its 40th anniversary in 2023.

The winner of ''[[Top Chef]]'', the [[reality television]] cooking competition, is featured in a spread in this magazine.
